14. Breakpoints and stack traces
A breakpoint pauses execution; a stack trace shows the call path near an error.
Breakpoint එJකන් execution නවත්වලා variables බලනවා. Stack trace එJකන් error එකට ආපු
Checkout calls calcTotal which reads an undefined price.

checkout() · calcTotal() · Call chain ↓ · readPrice() · Error location · TypeError · Read the diagram: checkout() → calcTotal() → readPrice() → TypeError. · Breakpoint එJකන් execution නවත්වලා variables බලනවා. Stack trace එJකන් error එකට ආපු function calls · බලනවා.
Expected result: TypeError; stack identifies readPrice and its caller.

Q: What is step over vs step into?
A: Step over executes the current call without entering it; step into enters the called function.
